headline: Unbeaten Lincoln meet Truman, who have already held them
dek: Lincoln won at Indianapolis, the last side to draw with them, and are fourteen wins and four draws into the season without defeat. All four of those draws came away from home, one of them at Truman, who won at Missouri-St. Louis the same day and now travel to Lincoln.
displaced_by: Lincoln won at Indianapolis, so the match the old headline previewed is now played and the dek's win total and run are out of date

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southwest Baptist have scored forty-five goals, more than either Lincoln or Drury near the top, but they have conceded thirty-six and lost seven times; the leaders have built their place at the other end of the pitch.

wire.line: Lincoln are the only programme in the conference still without a defeat this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches past their date carry no result, and both are Drury's, one at home and one away, both from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Drury have lost four times this season: at home to Oklahoma Christian in August, away at Missouri S&T in September, and at home to Lincoln and to Missouri-St. Louis in October.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Jonathan Nemorden, a freshman, has twelve of Lincoln's forty goals, from sixty-five shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Jacob Panagos, a midfielder, has fifteen of Truman's twenty-eight goals, from fifty-five shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Noah Nymark-Pedersen has made seventy-nine saves for Upper Iowa and conceded thirty-five, a save percentage of .693.

last_match.line: Indianapolis had not lost at home since Maryville won there in September.

next_match.line: Lincoln have won every match they have played at home; Truman held them to a draw in September.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
